verdict.rationale: First-party docs give a ready-to-run container command, container-image and Kubernetes Operator install guides, production database setup (PostgreSQL), reverse-proxy configuration and health endpoints. Community reports independently confirm long-running self-hosted production deployments, though some note high memory use and container friction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the open-source license or terms for self-hosting, and resource-footprint caveats (around 2 GiB RAM) noted by users.
